correctness.rationale: Under |R|<=P=BW with P irreducible, equality in the max-modulus convexity chain for Ru=u forces every active |s_j|=1 and a consistent vertex sign gauge; conversely a gauge h yields Rh=h. An unbalanced R has no eigenvalue 1, and R-I is Hurwitz because spectrum(R) lies in the unit disk. Bounded martingale noise and a Lyapunov matrix give a.s. convergence to 1/2. In the balanced case the sign gauge converts the two-layer dynamics to ordinary nonnegative reinforcement; m_t=πy_t is a bounded martingale and nontrivial transverse modes decay a.s. by the same Lyapunov argument, including P periodic. Conditional independence gives Var ξ>=Σ(πB)_j² p_j(0)(1-p_j(0))>0 for strictly interior z0. Exact independently computed n=4 example P=J/4, h=(+,+,-,-), lower bound 1/16; finite example is not the general proof.
